Oneliner

Commercial constellation for IoT/M2M.
Description

Space-based Internet of Things (IoT) and Machine-to-Machine (M2M) service specifically designed for market applications that require low bandwidth and low service costs. Monitoring and messaging service that will track and provide communication with up to 5 billion transmitters, through 30 MHz of S-band spectrum.
